3: Saver costs 45 + 44 + … down to 15 at the 31st journey. After n journeys (n ≤ 31) Saver totals n(91 − n)/2; at n = 31 this is 930 = 31 × 30, the same as Standard. The 32nd journey costs 15 on Saver vs 30 on Standard, so Saver becomes cheaper at the 32nd journey.
4: Density = population ÷ area. Green Territory: 180,000 ÷ 90,000 = 2 per km², far lower than any other (Remote Isles is 20). It's in option C.
